|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ラック・シヴラックの酒飲み仲間。フローーン・ランプロイドの女性。突起で獲物に毒を刺す狩猟者。フォースに同調し、時間の流れを変えることができるという。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Dice Ibegon.

'''Card text:''' When an opposing character fires a weapon at the same site, you may use 1 Force to attack with her appendage, once per turn. Choose a target and draw destiny. The attack hits if destiny equals the target's ability.

'''Lore:''' Lak Sivrak's drinking companion. A female Florn Lamproid, a hunter who injects poison into prey with a protruding appendage. She is attuned to the Force, with a reputation for being able to alter the flow of time.
